question: 张坤目前在管的基金有几只？管理总规模是多少？
first_sql: SELECT m.PSN_NAME AS `基金经理名称`, m.FUND_NUM_ACTUAL AS `在管基金数量`, ROUND(m.NET_VALUE / 100000000, 2) AS `管理总规模（亿）` FROM FUND_MANAGER_INFO m WHERE m.PSN_NAME = '张坤' AND m.HISVALID = 1 AND CASE WHEN m.NET_VALUE != 0 THEN m.MV_OF_STOCK / m.NET_VALUE ELSE 0 END >= 0.447 AND CASE WHEN m.MV_OF_STOCK != 0 THEN (m.MV_OF_STOCK - m.MV_OF_STOCK_PASSIVE) / m.MV_OF_STOCK ELSE 0 END >= 0.5
final_sql: SELECT m.PSN_NAME AS `基金经理名称`, m.FUND_NUM_ACTUAL AS `在管基金数量`, ROUND(m.NET_VALUE / 100000000, 2) AS `管理总规模（亿）` FROM FUND_MANAGER_INFO m WHERE m.PSN_NAME = '张坤' AND m.HISVALID = 1 AND CASE WHEN m.NET_VALUE != 0 THEN m.MV_OF_STOCK / m.NET_VALUE ELSE 0 END >= 0.447 AND CASE WHEN m.MV_OF_STOCK != 0 THEN (m.MV_OF_STOCK - m.MV_OF_STOCK_PASSIVE) / m.MV_OF_STOCK ELSE 0 END >= 0.5
